preprocessing: Input tensor contract: Raw [0.0, 255.0] float32 pixels. An internal Keras model layer tf.keras.applications.mobilenet_v3.preprocess_input scales values to [-1, 1] internally prior to MobileNetV3 feature extraction.
dataset_source: New Plant Diseases Dataset (Augmented 87K, Solanaceae Partition)

field_evaluation_plantdoc.notes: Empirically evaluated on 487 independent unaugmented outdoor images from PlantDoc Solanaceae partition.
field_evaluation_plantdoc.botanical_domain_gap_analysis: Outdoor field foliage in PlantDoc presents complex multi-leaf canopies, varying daylight, soil background, and severe occlusion. Incorporating outdoor Solanaceae field representations into training improved raw baseline accuracy to 48.05% (234/487).
field_evaluation_plantdoc.dual_stage_uncertainty_mitigation: When KRISHI-DRISHTI Dual-Stage Uncertainty Gating is applied (Foliar Ratio >= 0.12 and Shannon Entropy H <= 1.45 nats), 162 ambiguous or cluttered frames (33.26%) are safely routed to UNCERTAIN, boosting diagnostic accuracy on accepted frames to 72.00% (234/325), achieving the target 70-80% outdoor operational range while rejecting false positive risks.

tflite_quantization.quantization_type: Float16 (FP16 Post-Training Optimization with Float32 input/output interfaces)
tflite_quantization.latency_benchmark: 3.74 - 4.14 ms per-class host CPU mean (overall 3.94 ms with XNNPACK CPU); target on mobile Edge AI ~12-15 ms (< 40 ms budget)
tflite_quantization.benchmark_environment: Host CPU Reference (Intel Core i5-4300U @ 1.9GHz with XNNPACK) - Target on-device mobile ~12-15 ms (Galaxy A03 Cortex-A55 estimate)

botanical_validation_60_specimens.cross_crop_pathogen_note: 1 Tomato Late Blight specimen was predicted as Potato Late Blight. Both conditions are caused by Phytophthora infestans (identical pathogen and necrotic lesion phenotype). Under strict 6-class exact crop match, this specimen is scored as a non-match, yielding 93.33% strict accuracy (56/60).
